incident.name: Resolv USR unbacked mint
incident.summary: Compromised Resolv minting key minted ~80M unbacked USR; USR depegged on secondary markets while Morpho oracles that hardcode USR = $1 (USR, wstUSR via exchange rate, RLP via Resolv feed) kept pricing collateral at par. Borrowers posted cheap collateral and borrowed USDC/AUSD at oracle value until supplied liquidity hit 100% utilization.
incident.protectiveActionRule: first vault event on that market that reduces or stops exposure: SetCap to 0, SubmitMarketRemoval, ReallocateWithdraw initiated by an allocator that is not the Public Allocator, SetSupplyQueue dropping the market, or SetFlowCaps on the Public Allocator setting maxIn to 0 for that market
incident.units: supplyAssets/borrowAssets/withdrawable are in loan token units (USDC/AUSD, ~USD). oraclePrice/marketPrice are USD per 1 collateral token.

sources: Morpho Blue 0xBBBBBbbBBb9cC5e90e3b3Af64bdAF62C37EEFFCb market(id) and position(id,user) eth_call at historical blocks (Ethereum via eth.drpc.org; Base via base.drpc.org)
Oracle price() eth_call at historical blocks (MorphoChainlinkOracleV2 contracts listed per market)

Logs via eth_getLogs on mainnet.gateway.tenderly.co / base.gateway.tenderly.co (Morpho Blue, MetaMorpho vaults, PublicAllocator 0xfd32fA2ca22c76dD6E550706Ad913FC6CE91c75D / Base 0xA090dD1a701408Df1d4d0B85b716c87565f90467)
